description: This Java class defines an Android activity that prompts the user to install Google Voice Search if it is not installed. It provides a button to open the market link for Voice Search and handles the click events accordingly.

classes.name: VoiceInputNotInstalledActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that informs the user that voice input is not installed and provides a way to install it via the market.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and assigns click listeners to buttons.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events for the install and no buttons; attempts to open the market for Voice Search or finishes the activity.
